hooks.text: Staff measured a growing bend. Two days later, the Quebec Bridge fell.
What happened after Quebec Bridge staff measured a growing bend?
The bridge might have been doomed. The loss of life might have been prevented.

title: The Bend Measured Before Quebec Bridge Fell
description: Quebec Bridge staff measured an enlarging lower-chord bend before the 1907 collapse. The Royal Commission did not believe action after August 27 could have prevented the fall, but found better judgment might have prevented the loss of life.

beats.text: The commission found the lower members were defectively designed.

beats.text: It did not believe the fall preventable after August 27.

beats.text: Seventy-five workers died. Better judgment, the commission said, might have saved lives. The bend had been measured.

better_than_last: The exact 1907 sources stay pinned, beat 3 has a distinct photographic composition, and the commission’s qualified human-loss finding ends by echoing the measured bend.
